title: 希尔魂刃 Shyran Spiritblade
prerequisite: 萨满且剑法师，阿坎努（Akanûl）地区背景
body:
**希尔魂刃 Shyran Spiritblade**
「My blade's edge is keen, but my spirit's power can cut just as deeply.」

**前提条件：萨满且剑法师，阿坎努（Akanûl）地区背景**

In the days of old Shyr, the practices of the swordmage were forbidden to all but the favored of the ruling primordial Karshimis. Many genasi, however, took to the wilds outside of civilization to learn their ancestral craft in secret. Deep in the wilds, some of these students found masters that had become sympathetic with the primal world, carrying on an ancient discipline that blended arcane prowess with primal resonance. You have carried on this tradition, calling your spirit ally to your mystic blade, resulting in a fighting style unknown to almost all others on Toril.

You have an intense bond to both your blade and your spirit friend, such that both have become inseparable from you. You often act as an emissary between the wilds of the frontier and the learned halls of civilization, spending time in both worlds. Your balanced upbringing means others often rely upon you to be the source of stability when things go awry.

**11级：希尔精魂防卫 Shyran Spirit Warding**

**增益：**当你的精魂伙伴邻近你时，你在强韧，反射和意志上获得+1加值。

**11级：魂刃行动  Spiritblade's Action**

**增益：**每当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，所有邻近你精魂伙伴的敌人被你标记，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：图腾之刃 Totem Blade**

**增益：**你可以将一把轻刃或重刃作为法器来使用萨满威能和希尔魂刃威能。

**12级：合一之剑 One with the Blade**

**16级：不破链接 Unbreakable Bond**

**增益：**如果你的精魂伙伴因为对它造成的伤害将要消失，则以一个自由动作，你可以代替它受到该伤害，如果你这样做，你的精魂伙伴不受该攻击的影响。

title: 希望之焰 Flame of Hope
body:
**希望之焰 Flame of Hope**
「我并不期盼善行，我只是希望我的行为可以在他人心中点燃善良的火焰。」

**前提条件：神导士**

在混沌初开之时，众神与魔神之间进行了一场大战。众神是为给他们所创造的这个世界带来希望而战斗。若将世界让给魔神的话，那么这片大地将会变成充满恐惧的土地，魔神会残暴地随意支配、破坏和改造这个世界。所有生活在这个世界上的生灵都会沦为奴隶，就如同矮人被魔神的奴仆泰坦奴役着一样。最好的情况也不过是为了生存而在恐惧中奔跑、在绝望中躲藏，不知何时魔神暴君的毁灭就会降临到自己头上。

但是正因为众神击败了魔神，并将这个世界从魔神的支配下解放出来。凡间的各个种族们才能怀有希望继续生活下去。你的神圣信条就是守护这世界上希望的火星，让它们燃烧为燎原之火，照亮这世界上最黑暗的角落。

作为一名希望之焰，你掌握着炽烈的光明之力，在灼烧并刺盲敌人双目的同时，带给同伴治疗和鼓励。

**11级：激励打击 Inspiring Attack Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行攻击时，你和每个离你5格内的盟友，在对此攻击的每个目标的攻击骰上获得等同于你智力调整值的加值，直到你下一回合开始。

**11级：久远希望 Enduring Hope**

**增益：**当你未重伤时，每个离你5格内的盟友在豁免检定上获得+1加值。

**11级：神焰瀑雨 Numinous Cascade**

⟦神焰瀑雨 Numinous Cascade⟧

**12级：目盲结界 Blinding Ward**

⟦目盲结界 Blinding Ward⟧

**16级：正义复苏 Righteous Resurgence**

**增益：**当你使用你的回气时，每个离你5格内的敌人受到1d6 + 你智力调整值的火焰和光耀伤害，且每个离你5格内的盟友获得等同于此伤害数值的临时生命值。

⟦阳光堡垒 Sunburst Bulwark⟧

title: 牺牲之子 Scion of Sacrifice
prerequisite: 圣武士，⟦炽热誓约 Ardent Vow⟧威能
body:
**牺牲之子 Scion of Sacrifice**
「你的恐吓对我而言毫无意义，你说什么都无法挽回你的性命。」

**前提条件：圣武士，⟦炽热誓约 Ardent Vow⟧威能**

你的核心价值观和你的言行准则让你愿意为更宏伟的目标而献出生命。你坚韧而决绝，从不会因可能会失去某些力量而放弃帮助他人。你灌注神力的每一次挥砍都将磨练你的身体和意志并使你变得更加强大。你通过你所击败的敌人来衡量自己的加值。

作为牺牲之子，你总是保持热忱，无论环境如何，你都渴望你哪些背弃信仰的敌人相遇。当他人止步且深思时，你总是行动在前——无论结果是好是坏。然而，你并非是在谋求自杀。若你遇见一个难以应对的敌人时，你会选择暂时退却，直到你成长到实力与他相差无几的时候。或者你可能转而去帮助那些身处险境的同伴，亦或去帮助那些受伤之人远离战场。但在战斗的时刻，你往往冷酷无畏。不论你是在击倒强敌的路上身死还是幸存下来并在明天寻找新的威胁，你明白，这都取决于神的意志。

**11级：不屈勇毅 Unflinching Persistence**

**增益：**你每日能额外使用一次⟦炽热誓约 Ardent Vow⟧。

**11级：毁灭行动 Devastating Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行一次攻击时，此攻击造成等同于你魅力调整值的额外伤害。若你重伤，则你将你的感知调整值加在此额外伤害上。

**12级：牺牲之治愈 Scion's Healing**

⟦牺牲之治愈 Scion's Healing⟧

**增益：**当一次攻击让你的生命值变为0或更低时，在失去意识之前，你能以一个自由动作使用一个随意威能。

**20级：惩戒之火 Punishing Flame**

title: 蜥王之怒专家 Basilisk's Fury Adept
body:
**蜥王之怒专家 Basilisk's Fury Adept**
「目光所及，劫数将至。」

**前提条件：武僧**

石化蜥蜴以其非凡的捕猎技巧和无情的石化凝视著称。结合它的蜿蜒机动和石化凝视，一群武僧开发了相应的招式，复现了这可怕生物的威能。

你对狂怒的石化蜥蜴的研究为你的心灵打开了一张大门，不限于自己，你能感受到周围人们的情绪。这种状态使你心身空灵，将其他人的情感尽收眼底。敌人若敢与你黑曜石般的冰冷眼神对视，会失去所有希望和勇气。留给他的只有漠然、凝滞和死亡。

**11级：凶猛行动 Baleful Action**

**增益：**你可以花费一个行动点使每个离你5格内的能看见你的敌人迟缓，直到你下一回合开始。任何以此方式迟缓的敌人受到伤害时，则变为迟缓（豁免终止）。

**11级：蜥王灵动 Basilisk's Boon**

**增益：**你在对抗定身、束缚或迟缓的豁免检定上获得+2加值。当你受到一个石化你的效果影响时，你可以对此效果进行一次豁免检定。若豁免成功，则此效果结束。

**增益：**当你使用武僧或蜥王之怒专家攻击威能对一个敌人造成重击时，该敌人石化（豁免终止）。

title: 席德瑞恩信徒 Seldarine Dedicate
prerequisite: 雅灵或精灵，牧师，擅长长弓或短弓
body:
**席德瑞恩信徒 Seldarine Dedicate**
「科瑞隆指引我的心，席德瑞恩引导我的箭。」

**前提条件：雅灵或精灵，牧师，擅长长弓或短弓**

The Seldarine, the fellowship of brothers and sisters of the woods, comprises Corellon, Sehanine, and the other gods and exarchs who dwell in the dominion of Arvandor. Revered by elves and eladrin alike, these gods watch over and protect their favored scions. Elf and eladrin clerics often worship one or another of the Seldarine, but a few pay homage to the whole, drawing their power from Arvandor's combined wisdom.

As a Seldarine dedicate, you occupy a high position within your temples. You and the few others like you enjoy a broader connection to the gods of Arvandor than other clerics do, and you know methods for communing with them. You draw a bow as readily as you raise your holy symbol to focus your prayers.

Your weapon is inscribed with sigils and runes, which flare with emerald light when you fire a shot with a whispered prayer.

**11级：予弓荣誉 Honor the Bow**

**增益：**你能以长弓或短弓作为法器来使用牧师和席德瑞恩信徒的法器威能。当你通过长弓或短弓来使用法器威能时，你将该武器的增强加值，若有的话，加到该威能的攻击骰与伤害骰上，但你不能使用该武器的擅长加值。若你以魔法长弓或短弓作为法器并造成重击时，你使用该武器的重击效果。

**11级：重整行动 Renewing Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你同时在此遭遇中获得一次额外的⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧使用次数。

**11级：月之光束 Moonbeam**

⟦月之光束 Moonbeam⟧

**12级：群星帷幕 Shroud of Stars**

⟦群星帷幕 Shroud of Stars⟧

**16级：诸神之步 Footsteps of the Gods**

**增益：**当你使用牧师和席德瑞恩信徒的法器威能时，在使用该威能之前或之后，你能以一个自由动作快步1格。

title: 夏尔骑士 Shiere Knight
body:
**夏尔骑士 Shiere Knight**
「以夏后王庭的名义，你将为你的冒犯付出代价！」

**前提条件：雅灵**

很多贵族的雅灵，包括《怪物图鉴》中的秋风剑客和冬霜护法，在家族中占据着举足轻重的位置并拥有指挥其他成员的权利。一少部分雅灵英雄把捍卫整个种族的尊严看做高于家族的事情。尽管受到贵族的资助，这些夏尔骑士仍然是不受限制的。他们并不专门保护单个家族的利益，而是专心于对付废陋巨人、矮腿妖及其他来自于妖精荒野的敌人。

成为一名夏尔骑士不仅仅是得到一个头衔。作为种族的守护者，你成为了妖精荒野力量的化身。你的外表被妖野力量标记：暗淡的光亮笼罩着你的身体、隐隐的火焰在你的双眼中燃烧、狂乱的气流环绕在你的周围，或是其他一些超自然地特征。你可以用这些力量误导你的敌人，并让他们走向恐惧的深渊。

**增益：**你可以花费一个行动点传送10格，而不是进行额外动作。

body:
**先锋铁卫 Iron Vanguard**
「我随着自己的每一次攻击而变得更加强壮与自信。」

**前提条件：战士**

你的英姿毫无破绽，力大无穷，并且一往无前，执着于胜利。轻松地占领阵地并且击退来犯之敌，没有人在战斗的前线能够比你守得更好。

title: 鲜血狂暴者 Bloodfury Savage
body:
**鲜血狂暴者 Bloodfury Savage**
「我要挖出你的心肝儿下酒吃！」

**前提条件：半兽人**

你的体内同时流淌的人类和兽人的血液，这造就了你无以伦比的凶猛和适应能力。半兽人通常拥有人类和兽人最好的特征。然而在你的内心深处依然渴望着战鼓的喧嚣和暴力的野蛮。你徘徊在无法忍耐的狂怒的边缘，它们在激烈的战斗中如洪水般爆发。只有无尽的杀戮才能满足你饥渴的灵魂时，因为你为鲜血而生。

你的一生都能感受到自己身体中激烈的战斗，人类与兽人天性之间的战斗抵制了你分裂的人性。在内心的战斗中，你得到了强大的威能，巨大的力量，以及破坏的能力。你将在战斗中化身为无情的风暴，对你的敌人释放你对鲜血的渴望，并且将恐惧留给他们的余生。

title: 鲜血骑士 Bloodknight
prerequisite: 防御者职位，⟦吸血鬼传统 <吸血鬼血统> Vampiric Heritage <Vampire Bloodline>⟧专长
body:
**鲜血骑士 Bloodknight**
「不论我所接受的教养是何等堕落与邪恶，如今在那些我从小被教育应该视其为家畜的人们心中,我是一位英雄。」

**前提条件：防御者职位，⟦吸血鬼传统 <吸血鬼血统> Vampiric Heritage <Vampire Bloodline>⟧专长**

你的吸血鬼血统只是为了把你磨练成一个更强大的勇士。你可能成长于一个吸血鬼氏族中，并且被塑造和磨砺成了一把执行他们意志的完美武器。许多和你走上同一条路的人都有着这样的历史。也有可能，是你听到了你的血脉的低语，赢得了超自然的天赋作为努力的回报。敌人的鲜血争相涌入你的身躯。你能感觉到，被你标记的敌人面对死亡的惊慌，就如同围猎中的狼嗅到的恐惧。你的对手只不过是被驱赶到了你选定的猎场的牺牲品，终归难逃被击毙在地，用于补充你的力量的命运。

**11级：血之感召行动 Blood-Calling Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次额外攻击时，你同时将近程爆发2范围内的所有敌人标记，直到你下一回合结束。

**增益：**每当你擒拿一名被你标记的目标时，你可以立即以一个自由动作对该目标使用⟦鲜血汲取 Blood Drain⟧威能。

title: 衔尾巨蛇信使 Disciple of the World Serpent
prerequisite: 萨满，⟦呼唤精魂伙伴 Call Spirit Companion⟧威能
body:
**衔尾巨蛇信使 Disciple of the World Serpent**
「这整个世界是被安置在衔尾巨蛇的盘绕之中。肯向祂学习，你就能得到智慧。」

**前提条件：萨满，⟦呼唤精魂伙伴 Call Spirit Companion⟧威能**

传说中，衔尾巨蛇是最伟大的太初精魂，祂设立了自然界的律法，并且是这律法最可靠的保卫者。当有异神主教和魔神信徒试图合作干扰自然律法之时，衔尾巨蛇将立刻出现并夺走他们的生命。据说，大地是被放置在衔尾巨蛇的盘绕之中，而祂的活动则是地震的成因。

作为一名衔尾巨蛇之信使，你有义务要维持自然律法的平衡，并确保凡界之外的生物待在它们所应在之处。你持有衔尾巨蛇的力量，并用其牙来刺穿敌人，用其盘旋之躯来压碎他们。你的精魂伙伴就如同衔尾巨蛇的回响，以其身形来阻碍敌人。衔尾巨蛇的毒液增强了你的降魂术，让脱离你的威能影响的生物中毒。

Ancient sites such as these might hold information on how Melora's faithful can benefit from them.

Each aspiring Oak Shield studies under a master. Together, the student and the master meditate beneath a sacred oak, seeking enlightenment about the natural world. The student learns to interpret the whispers of the primal spirits and to understand the wisdom of the changing seasons. During this time, he or she comes to appreciate when to stand tall against the wind and when to bend when the wind is too strong. In addition, the student learns about the complexity of the world, how something as simple as a tree can have multiple aspects to its nature. title: 协调领袖 Concordant Leader
body:
**协调领袖 Concordant Leader**
「The elements blend together favorably within my soul and on any battlefield where I have command.」

**前提条件：元素裔，督军**

Within the Elemental Chaos, disparate elements battle for supremacy. In numerous places, the land, sky, and sea roil in a never-ending clash of lightning and fire, poison gas and rolling earth, biting water and tearing wind. The chaos is much like a worldly battlefield on which no leader exerts control. Where one element dominates, the will of a mighty force of nature is often what makes it so.

The unrestrained chaos is much like a worldly battlefield on which no skilled leader exerts control. In such a combat zone, forces clash without clear direction. The tide of battle is all too often determined merely by fate. Clear advantage on one side or the other can rarely be overcome. One side overwhelms the other by happenstance or because of uneven odds. Victory is won at too heavy a cost.

A mythological genasi general of the ancient world, Vyn-kazi, knew the price of warfare's chaos all too well. She had witnessed it. Like the entropic realm from which they sprang, the great Primordials warred with the gods with no common purpose and no organization—no plan at all. Most of these mighty beings were fractious and grasping loners with armies of fierce slaves. They all but allowed the gods to coordinate against them. One by one, each and its armies succumbed to the gods and their legions.

Vyn-kazi survived a disastrous battle in which her master, Nekal of the Glowing Deep, fell against a host that included Pelor, Kord, Bane, Ioun, and Sehanine. The watersoul genasi went on to swear fealty to Pelor and to take on a firesoul aspect in his name. She then led her people against other Primordials in service to the god of the sun, taking the calm blending of two elements in her spirit and what she had witnessed in Nekal's defeat as models for her command style.

Similar to celebrated Vyn-kazi, you have learned to mingle and control the elements that cavort in your body and spirit. Your military training has taught you how to guide a combat to triumph by blending the skills of your allies with the needs and variables of the challenge. You have applied your life's lessons to your teaching, acknowledging that every clash is a meeting of contrasting elements. By carefully mixing those forces, you need not rely on fortune for your success.

title: 亵渎大师 Master Defiler
body:
**亵渎大师 Master Defiler**
「What does it matter if a few plants die to fuel my ambitions?」

**前提条件：⟦奥术亵渎 Arcane Defiling⟧威能**

The lowly and the ignorant see defilers as craven and corrupt—little more than thieves with magical talent. It's true that the defiler's path is selfish in its way: A defiler requires energy from associates and the living world nearby to power his or her greatest spells. And it is also true is that defiling can corrupt the body and mind. But only a fool could fail to see the power that defiling offers, and you are not a fool.

Most who openly defile enjoy the protection of high station or powerful patrons. Perhaps you are of noble birth, and your family's wealth protects you from the consequences of your actions. You might have been chosen for an arcane education while still young and tutored in the ways of magic by templar instructors, or perhaps you gained the king's sanction by other means—as a reward for some great service to the king or the city, through bribery, or by the manipulation of powerful nobles or senior templars exercising the king's favor. If you are not a native of a city-state, the only sanction you require is sheer power: You can defile freely if your tribe protects you, or if you are so powerful that no one dares to challenge you.

If you are one of a sorcerer-king's sanctioned defilers, you might be expected to make yourself available for special tasks or duties as needed. Such assignments are rare, however; most sorcerer-kings allow master defilers in their cities to do more or less as they wish, trusting that they won't jeopardize the city or themselves. After all, master defilers are universally loathed, and if anything ever happens to the king, even a master defiler wouldn't last a day.

Dabbling in occult mysteries carries a heavy price in body, mind, and soul. To harness the magic these entities offer, you must carve your f lesh with blasphemies. To understand the rites, you must push your mind to madness's brink. To prepare your soul, you must indulge in every evil, wallowing in the horror of it all.

Where paladins fight for honor, good, and order, idols of darkness are treacherous, wicked, and capricious in their dealings. They kill for pleasure. They maim to learn from their victim's suffering. body:

「站在我身后，朋友！他们别想再伤到你。」

**前提条件：圣武士**

你是行走的堡垒，保护着手无寸铁之人。你是狂岚中的灯塔，让弱小免受风雨摧残。作为信仰之盾，你将同伴的幸福与健康置于自己之上。

即使与整个世界大多数信徒所比较，信仰之盾也能称得上是其中最虔诚的战士与表率。他们中多数守卫着圣地，忠诚地执行神的旨意。而另一些则游历于世界各处，用他们的才能和力量去帮助那些最需要帮助的人——不论是被敌人包围的边境小镇居民亦或是正致力于挫败可怕阴谋的冒险家。

信仰之盾坚信，与其想方设法制造伤害，不如为同伴创造赢得胜利所需要的时间和一切帮助。你或许与另一名防御者合作，组成一道坚不可摧的城墙；又或者与一名打击者合作，为队友开辟前路。当你的团队面临重压时，你也可能会选择掩护撤退，直至队友逃离到安全区域。

body:
**星辰之刃 Astral Weapon**
「我的体内流淌着来自众星之海的力量，我为我神的意志而战。」

**前提条件：圣武士**

你成为你的神的武器，被额外灌输了来自众星之海的神力。作为星辰之刃，没有你不能打倒的敌人，也没有你不能战胜的挑战，你的信仰坚定，你的武器吟颂着天界的荣光。当你踏上这条道路之后，你的武器将永远散发着来自众星之海的银色光芒。

body:
**星界诞星 Astral Ascendant**
"Your meager abilities will not help you against the greatest mind ever to take the field of batitle.”

**前提条件：邪术师，「遗灵契约」**

While pouring through ancient tomes during your studies, you came across mention of a skilled young general. His ability to drive soldiers to greatness and forge decisive victories against the deadliest foes was the subject of many ballads and stories. This young commander excelled so much at his chosen tasks that an ancient god brought the general to the Astral Sea, tasking him to command and train the angels of Mount Celestia.

As an Astral Ascendant, you have become the embodiment of the greatest general and tactician that ever lived. Your commands send your allies screaming into battle, encircled with the pure radiance of the Astral Sea, which grants empowerment, protection, and healing. Your presence on the battlefield is enough to turn the tide of war in your favor.

Crimson;（风守注：考虑到「邪术师诅咒」后期官方修改成每回合一次，这里请DM自行斟酌是否修改成每回合一次）

You are a theologian, and you have devoted yourself to learning the nature of the gods and their dominions. Through years of study, you have developed a philosophy that grants you a deep understanding of higher realities and the properties of divine power.

As an astral savant, you use your uncanny insights to tap into the raw power of the forces that shape the Astral Sea, creating a wide range of effects with your prayers. You wield divine energy in ways that other clerics cannot, warding and sustaining your allies against their foes.

title: 星夜之主 Master of the Starry Night
body:
**星夜之主 Master of the Starry Night**
「星辰是在世界之外燃烧的光点。有些人认为它们是有害生物研究我们宇宙的窗口。在我看来，这充其量是一种对星辰的狭隘概念。」

**前提条件：邪术师，「星辰契约」**

你理解了星辰真正的本质，你的知识超过几乎所有其他生物。你已经研习了所有星辰契约邪术师的教科书。你发现那些典籍里的诠释如果是事实，那将是灾难性的。也许就像许多星辰契约邪术师所说的那样，有些星辰是通往遥远国度的窗口。然而，你怀疑许多星辰还有其他秘密。因此，你已经形成了一套新的信念。

用你的星图、星盘和观测镜，你已经确定了许多星辰的亮度和运动轨迹。你已经测量了它们的颜色，大小，以及最重要的，它们提供给邪术师的力量。你理解自然和魔法的共生关系，就是由星辰体现的，所以你们扭曲了你的契约，让你和你的同行有所不同。你不再害怕天空的深处，因为你是星夜之主。

title: 猩红猎手 Crimson Hunter
body:
**猩红猎手 Crimson Hunter**
「我嗅到你血液深处恐惧的臭味，猎物，你已无处可逃。」

**前提条件：巡者**

The spirits demand recompense for crimes committed against the natural world, and they accept payment only in blood. You are their collector. You range the land to exact the price your enemies must pay for violating the world. You are a relentless hunter, ruthless in your mien and efficient in your methods.

The spirits aid you in your efforts by imparting to you the ancient hunting methods of your people. Though your ancestors used these techniques to bring down game, you find them equally effective in eliminating your foes. Each time an enemy falls, you reaffirm your bond to your spirit guides, offering the fallen enemy as a sacrifice to slake their thirst until you next come upon a deserving foe.

As a crimson hunter, you focus on the striker elements found in many seeker evocations. The smell of blood provokes you, letting you move more quickly to engage your enemies. These techniques allow you to close the distance to bring an enemy in range or to skirt the battlefield for your next strike.

title: 幸运领袖 Captain of Fortune
body:
**幸运领袖 Captain of Fortune**
「运气在我们这边，我们要抓紧机会！」

**前提条件：督军**

You believe that a great destiny awaits anyone who has the audacity to take fate into his or her own hands. Self-awareness, confidence, and a sharp eye for opportunity allow a hero to reach a destiny, yet sometimes destiny needs a little bit of help. And that's where you come in.

You teach your comrades and followers the principles of self-empowerment to help them reach for greater heights. You believe that someone who is alert and grabs opportunities as they come can triumph against any adversary. A force of balance is at work within the world, and fortune, fate, luck, or chance—whatever you care to call it—gathers around the bold like an invisible mantle. Fortune rarely smiles for long on those who prey on others or who stand on the side of iniquity; their day of ill fortune comes eventually. You intend to be there when it does.

Those you lead see you as a good luck charm. They feel empowered in your presence, believing that you have a supernatural gift that improves their chances. You, on the other hand, understand that luck is made, not found. You know that if luck and fate do guide the destinies of you and your friends, without the proper effort and outlook, those destinies will never be fulfilled.

body:
**幸运祝福者 Fortune Blessed**
「The odds are stacked in my favor.」

**前提条件：任意神术职业，必须信仰艾梵德拉**

Serendipity favors you. You have long proved a constant and loyal servant to Avandra by making her interests your own in your ongoing struggle against tyranny and in your willingness to explore the world and sample all it has to offer. Your virtuous soul and good works have won you the goddess's favor, and although you know you were ever in her good graces, you realize you have only touched upon what is possible in her service.

Becoming fortune blessed makes luck your servant, yours to shape and manipulate as you desire. The goddess permits this mastery as long as you advance her aims in the world and remain pure of heart and purpose. You have a knack for husbanding your good fortune and turning setbacks to your advantage. The greater your power becomes, the more the impossible becomes possible until one day you find there is nothing you can't achieve with luck on your side.

**虚无后裔 Scion of Absence**
「设想一下你死后的时光。世界依然故我，有别之处仅在于你已不存于世。现在你可知晓你无法与空无搏斗，但它却是你消逝的原由？」

凡有形之物，虚无毁坏之。尝试攻击虚无是至极的徒劳，因为它并无弱点、不会受伤，更不存在能切断或者摧毁之形体。

虚无后裔研究并学习有关虚无之魂的反相之础石：万物的缺失。当中许多是贤明的战士或魔法的宗师，寻求可无为而达目的之法。其他人则彷彿自然的毁灭力量，无人可撄其锋。

**旋风元素裔 Whirlwind Genasi**
「只有白痴才会和风作对。」

**前提条件：元素裔，「狂风之魂」元素显能**

风是不朽的。空气无时无刻不在我们身边流动，空气是生命之源，但同时也能造成可怕的毁灭。飓风和风暴可以在一位国王面前把他的城堡摧毁，或者将一名伟大的英雄刮到山崖上摔死。尽管你的种族可以与所有的元素产生联系，但你对于空气则情有独钟，空气不止是你灵魂的一部分，也是你神奇力量的源泉。你是一名旋风元素裔，是凌驾于狂风之上的传奇

title: 旋刃舞者 Blade Dancer
body:
**旋刃舞者 Blade Dancer**
「Clashing blades create the rhythm for our final dance.」

**前提条件：游侠**

Halflings have long used music and a sense of fun to enliven physical labor and various dull tasks. When the race was young, they created dancelike movements that mimicked martial skills—and translated into deadliness in melee. Halflings learned that bladed weapons lent themselves easily to such a refined use. As their battle dances evolved, halflings began to consider the nimble use of a pair of bladed weapons a refinement of the style.

Halflings came to call skilled practitioners of this dual-weapon method blade dancers. The mingling of itinerant halflings with other peoples eventually made the blade dance famous. The blade-dancer way spread far and wide, and other folk adapted it to new weapon types. Today, numerous people know and teach the essentials of the method. The strictest masters require the student to show proficiency in combat as well as a love of life and wandering like that of halflings.

Halfling or not, you have put your body through a grueling regimen to attain mastery of the blade dance. Twin blades twirl about you like deadly veils. Intricate footwork allows you to dance in and out of danger with ease. Your weapons, like good dance partners, know where you want them to go almost before you do. One day, you and your weapons might dance your way into legend.

**11级：双刃攻势 Dual-Blade Action**

title: 旋塔战术家 Spiral Tactician
prerequisite: 雅灵，督军，「战术风采」职业特性
body:
**旋塔战术家 Spiral Tactician**
「我的妖精步舞都围绕同一个中心——胜利。」

**前提条件：雅灵，督军，「战术风采」职业特性**

妖精荒野，雅灵的故乡，是一个令人惊奇的世界。在那个位面，对美好的追求远胜世俗心，不过，邪恶也同样四处滋生。雅灵和人类一样易于堕落，在创世之初，黑暗精灵同样是妖精荒野的居民。

在远比某些伟大帝国的存在还漫长的岁月里，雅灵们跟随科瑞隆与罗丝女神的追随者和其他邪恶妖精进行着不懈的斗争。而战争的最高潮，被后世称为“旋塔决战”。在这次决战中，科瑞隆的跟随者们终于扭转劣势，英雄诞生！

奥珊德雅在旋塔决战刚开始时，是一个雅灵队长。黑暗精灵和恶魔在持久战期间设置了一个秘所关注着雅灵军的各个战线。在几次对敌控高塔的失败突袭中，奥珊德雅的上级纷纷捐躯。在后援无望的情况下，雅灵指挥官被迫领导残余部队对抗黑暗精灵。她利用了雅灵的妖精步舞设计了一次多路进攻，她冒了最大的风险，并且她不认为这是高塔的最终命运。最终，奥珊德雅的努力被证明是成功的。尽管旋塔最终沦为焦土，丧失了法力，但是雅灵们将黑暗精灵赶出了善良之地。

随着时间的推移，旋塔被重建了。奥珊德雅，作为将黑暗精灵赶出妖精荒野的诸战役生还者，终于超凡入圣。她是运筹帷幄的传奇督军。她的事迹被镌刻在旋塔的废墟之中。整个妖精荒野的雅灵勇士都在学习她卓越的战略和战术，其中有许多需要妖精力量。

你曾经研读过奥珊德雅的故事与作战计划，或者你拥有类似基于你精灵本性的谋略直觉。这可能是你生命中的一些潜在影响力的组合。你有坚定的战术思想，敏锐的空间与时间感，而且有使能力适合战术需要的才能。这些为你精通战斗而服务的天资，引导你拥有奥珊德雅的荣耀。

你虽然已拥有一家顶级奥术学院的文凭，但对于你来说这张纸只是一个形式罢了。你从多年的教育中所收获的其实是不可动摇的奥术原理基础，和你对运用这些力量的合理信心。自此以后，你已经掌握了魔法的基础知识，并开始像一位真正的艺术家一样对这些奥术能量加以编织。你通过判断其他人对魔法的沉着操控，以及他们知识与创造性的深度，来分辨出其他和你有着相同教育水平的专业人才。

title: 雪虎 Snow Tiger
body:
**雪虎 Snow Tiger**
「Death comes for you with two steel fangs. The Snow Tigers are upon you!」

**前提条件：游侠**

You have studied the ways of the Snow Tiger barbarians of the cold forests. You might count Snow Tigers among your relatives, having won their respect during your travels in their lands or as a youth fostered by the tribe. Or perhaps you befriended a Snow Tiger wanderer who taught you the woodcraft skills and fighting style of these fierce folk. You might be an enemy of the barbarians who has learned to mimic the wild fighting style of the Snow Tigers. Regardless of how you came to learn the way of the Snow Tigers, your knowledge makes you a warrior of unusual ferocity.

Like your barbarian fellows, you see little reason to use any weapon larger than a dagger. In your view, heavy armor and weapons are crutches; the true test of a warrior lies in strength and savagery. If you can't best your foe with a dagger, why should you fare any better with a bigger piece of steel? The predators of the northern lands—bear, tiger, wolf, and griffon—have nothing more than their own fangs and claws, and few humans can match those creatures' power and lethality.

Master of tundra and taiga, glacier and permafrost, you might be a bloody-handed reaver or a noble monster-slayer. Whichever path you choose to walk, you do so fearlessly, for you have the hard-won respect of the Snow Tiger warriors.

**前提条件：法师**

你把血和奥术方程结合在一起来施展更强大的法术——你自己的血。你的血就是你的生命，也是你的力量之源。很少有法师选择这条通向奥术大师的道路，因为这是一条需要沉湎于痛苦，浸泡于血液中的道路。但是你拥抱了这条血与魔法之路，并且你因为它而变得更加强大。

title: 血怒狂战士 Blood-Crazed Berserker
body:
**血怒狂战士 Blood-Crazed Berserker**
「杀！杀！杀！」

**前提条件：战士，邪恶阵营**

You have fought myriad battles, each a contest to determine who was strongest, who was most worthy of the champion's mantle. You survived these battles through brute strength, speed, and toughness, but you always sensed something else, something truly monstrous, threatening to break free in the thick of battle. At one glorious point, your prowess grew mighty enough that the monster emerged. It burst through your self-control and transformed you into a raging killer. All finesse, planning, and moderation fell away. Only an unspeakable craving for blood and a terrible talent for producing it remained.

Fighters are distinguished by a mastery at arms and the rigorous control they apply in desperate situations. Every warrior must come to terms with anger in combat, to channel it in useful ways lest he or she become ruled by it. To fail is to wind up dead, skewered on an enemy weapon. Still, a few fighters surrender completely to their anger, girding themselves in hatred's armor and powering their strikes with rampant ferocity.

**11级：血怒行动 Blood-Crazed Action**

Your bloodlust drives you to the brink of madness. Barely do you find self-control not to butcher everyone around you. When you dig deep and push beyond your normal limits, your hatred breaks free and sends you careening into the next foe.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来使用一个攻击威能时，你的冲锋攻击在攻击骰上获得+2威能加值，在伤害骰上获得+4加值，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：不可阻挡之杀手 Unstoppable Killer**

You are violence incarnate, a destructive killing machine. You will not pause, let up, or stop. Through supreme force of will, you can shake off conditions that would hinder a lesser warrior.

**增益：**你在对抗晕眩，被支配，定身，束缚和震慑状态的豁免检定上获得+2加值。

Moving across the battlefield, you leave tangled corpses in your wake—fitting punishment for those foolish enough to stand in your path.

⟦毁灭打击 Mutilating Strike⟧

**12级：源起之怒 Foaming Wrath**

Only the bravest or most foolish foe dares face you in battle. If that unlucky enemy manages to bleed you, it unleashes a storm of pain. When you use this power, you gnaw on your shield or foam at the mouth, eager for the next chance to strike.

⟦源起之怒 Foaming Wrath⟧

**16级：血腥侵略 Bloodied Aggression**

The greater your pain, the greater your threat on the battlefield. The injuries you sustain increase your strength, turning wild attacks into potentially killing blows.

**增益：**当你重伤时，你使用近战武器的攻击骰上获得+1加值，并且你的近战武器攻击掷出19-20时即可造成重击。

**20级：狂野怒火 Maniacal Fury**

Your hatred and anger are the stuff of legend. When sufficiently roused, you unleash your darker emotions, chewing through opponents in a brutal display. While in this state, you do not distinguish friend from foe. All are grist for the mill of your anger.

**血怒猎手 Bloodfury Hunter**
「愤怒？我会向你展示真正的愤怒！」

**前提条件：半兽化人，游侠**

Every ranger needs to tap into the beast inside; this task is especially simple for a shifter like you. You have honed your senses. You can smell blood in the air and hear the sound of your foe's racing heartbeat; at times, you can even taste the fear you inspire. By embracing the animal inside you, you become a true hunter.

Some shifters suppress their animal instincts, but you crave the adrenaline rush that comes over you when you unleash your inner beast. Your muscles are charged and your senses are enhanced. It's at these times that you feel alive and you are most dangerous to your enemies.

You gain resilience through unleashing the beast inside you. You have spent extensive time alone in the wild, where beasts were your only companions. You have studied them, watched the way they move and fight. Like them, when you become injured, you're even deadlier. You gain speed, strength, and ferocity. Your opponents would do well to eliminate you quickly; otherwise, they'll find that you're at your best when you're in the last throes of life.

在你从恶魔、偏差、以及其他可能破坏自然的平衡的存在手中保护世界的献身中，你发现自己渐渐变得接近原力之兽的完美形态。这种成长表现为你的血怒――在守护者形态下获得更快的速度，然后向你标示的敌人宣泄怒火。在这条道路的终点，你最终获得了呈现原力之兽形态的能力。

「今夜，红色的满月升上天空，这是血月之夜，吾之夜。」

**前提条件：德鲁伊，⟦野性变身 Wild Shape⟧威能**

有的传说讲述了血月，在一个夜晚甚至一个季度的时间内，太初之兽以实体漫步于这个世界的荒野。据说在血月出现期间，世界上的捕食者更为危险，也更为饥渴。按照某些传说的说法，血月是这个自然界的反常现象，是由神祗或者被冒犯的原始精魂所引发的。无论血月究竟是如何产生的，又有什么具体的效果，有的德鲁伊将其作为用以捍卫自然平衡的狂野激情的象征。

body:
**迅捷阔步者 Swift Strider**
「站在两极之间，一个你熟悉的世界，以及一个你永远无法触及的世界。」

**前提条件：巡者，「灵魂束约」职业特性**

You move with liquid grace and in a way that shows that you are unhindered by your environment. The primal spirits with whom you ally yourself guide your steps so that you can move without fear, boldly moving faster than your foes can track. You might use hidden pathways and shortcuts through the world. Or you might have taken your first step into the spirit world and, by doing so, now have the same freedom enjoyed by the land's spirit custodians.

Becoming a swift strider allows you to move with astonishing speed. You can anticipate your enemy's attacks and spring to safety. As you follow this path, your body begins to blur when you move, making it hard for foes to protect themselves from your strikes.

You attack while moving, spin away when your enemies hit you, and, eventually, speed through their ranks, delivering strikes that rob them of their mobility and increase your speed. By moving just outside the reach of your foes, you can deliver punishing attacks with your seeker powers to contain and control them so that your allies can move in for the kill.

title: 鸦后神眷 Ravenkin
prerequisite: 任意奥术职业，在宗教上受训
body:
**鸦后神眷 Ravenkin**

**前提条件：任意奥术职业，在宗教上受训**

From time to time, the Raven Queen's gaze lingers on a mortal soul whose courage and devotion sparks her cold heart. To these mortals she sends a special boon—a raven-shaped shadow whose appearance is a sign of her favor.

Those who gain this blessing are known as ravenkin, and from that point on they are never truly alone. The shadow raven that keeps them company is a physical connection to the god of death. Devout worshipers of the Raven Queen are the most common ravenkin. However, some ravenkin are recent converts to her faith, unsure of what they have done to warrant such a gift.

Since the blessing that marked you as a ravenkin, you have been aware that you are watched by the Raven Queen. Some might grow uneasy under such scrutiny, but you embrace it, knowing that you have a special place in the god's plans.

**11级：影鸦魔宠 Shadow Raven Familiar**

The raven that has come to you is a herald of the Raven Queen's favor and an omen of the destiny that opens before you. Its unreadable eyes watch you, giving the impression that it serves another even though it always does your bidding.

**增益：**你获得⟦影鸦 Shadow Raven⟧魔宠

As long as your shadow raven is perched on your shoulder, darkness can hold no secrets from you.

**增益：**当你的⟦影鸦 Shadow Raven⟧魔宠在被动模式下，你具有黑暗视觉

Melding your soul with the shadow raven, you learn to project your attacks through it. When you push yourself, your magic unfurls as a haze of shadow that lashes out at your unsuspecting foes.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来使用一个奥术攻击威能，且你的⟦影鸦 Shadow Raven⟧魔宠在主动模式时，该攻击可以把影鸦的空间作为起始点

⟦寒冬之鸦 Winter's Raven⟧

Your shadow raven is no stranger to combat, and proves it by harassing your enemies to thwart their defenses.

⟦鸦之侵掠 Raven Harrier⟧

**16级：鸦之连结 Bonded Raven**

The rapport you share with your shadow raven connects both of you in spirit and thought.

**增益：**你能和你的⟦影鸦 Shadow Raven⟧魔宠在10格内以心灵感应沟通。你必须有对它的效果线才能以此方式沟通。你的魔宠同时在所有防御上获得+2加值

You have served the Raven Queen well, and she rewards you in your time of need. From the cold heights of Letherna, a flock of shadow ravens is dispatched to fight at your side.

title: 鸦之先驱 Raven Herald
body:
**鸦之先驱 Raven Herald**
「一切事物都会终结。见证它是我的任务」

**前提条件：游荡者，必须信仰鸦后**

The transition to death is a holy road on which all living things are pilgrims. Every creature steps onto that road at birth. When fate's appointed hour comes, every creature steps off into whatever waits beyond the finite and visible path. So it has been, and so it should be. These are the truths of the Raven Queen.

Yet some do not hold to the proper path. Brazen mortals defy the natural order by avoiding that righteous hour of ending. A few do so by magic or other means, the most common of which is to become undead.

Undead aren't, in and of themselves, offensive to the Raven Queen. Still, shambling dead brought back to a mockery of life through foul magic deserve to be destroyed. So do those undead that defy true death by serving other entities, such as Orcus or Vecna. A few bold souls manage to elude death without otherwise blaspheming the Raven Queen's edicts. Still, demise must come for them in time as well.

It is the duty of any who serve the Raven Queen to bring down the proud, showing them the equality that only death provides. Within temples where the Raven Queen is esteemed above all others, the clergy offers support and training for those who would be her instruments of death. Cults form around the ideal of righteous killing, of becoming heralds of death. Common folk know of the Raven Queen's heralds and whisper of their mission when sudden loss of life visits the prideful, the wicked, or those cursed by undeath.

You have consciously devoted yourself to becoming a tool in the Raven Queen's wintry hands. Perhaps you came to this commitment on your own, or maybe you have an affiliation with the Raven Queen's hierarchy in the world. The origin of your connection to the mistress of winter makes little difference. As a harbinger of destiny, you know that every foe who falls before you has met its appropriate end.

**严冬怒火 Winter Fury**
「万物在春天复苏，除了你。」

**前提条件：野蛮人**

冬天与死亡是自然循环的一部分，旧的消亡为新生让出了道路。你是一个杀手，一个冬天的使者。你将带走敌人的生命，让他们成为新生的培土。

冬天是自然用来淘汰弱者的测试。你试图拥抱冬天。从比山之巅更高的寒冷的天空精魂交流。从那极北的寒冷荒地精魂获取饥寒怒火。用寒冷的愤怒武装自己。

title: 岩石赐福者 Stoneblessed
body:
**岩石赐福者 Stoneblessed**
「山里有什么？让我掰开来瞧瞧！」

**前提条件：歌利亚斯**

谁也说不清歌利亚斯的血统和他们所居住的山脉的联系。如同这些山脉一样，歌利亚斯从不畏惧围绕着他们的生活的狂风暴雪和悬崖峭壁。大多数的歌利亚斯骄傲于居高立下的力量，但有少数则开始体现山脉的精神。

你就是这样的一个英雄，一个歌利亚斯岩石赐福者，与岩石和山脉有着非同寻常的联系。脚下岩石鼓舞着你，大地的元素滋养着你，直到有一天你成为故乡峰顶的化身。你可以从岩石岩石中抽取力量，从而超越凡人的形态，作出惊人的动作。你的攻击有如山倾地裂。当你到达此典范之道的顶峰，你可以变成一块实体的石头，压碎那些想干掉你的敌人。

当你踏上这条道路，作为你与山脉之间紧密联系的体现，你的特性和形体也会缓慢变形。你的皮肤如砂岩一般坚硬，保护你不受伤害；你的眼睛失去水分变得如钻石般闪耀，反射出彩虹般的光芒；石质皮肤紧贴着你的肩膀，你的肘部也变成晶体。这些特性标志着你是一个真正的守护者，是歌利亚斯的英雄！

**野火元素裔 Wildfire Genasi**
「把你的剑放回鞘里，白痴，否则我就把它熔成废铁。」

有人说，炽热的火焰存在于每个元素裔的内心之中，不过就算这是真的，那也无法与你体内那狂暴的地狱烈焰相比。你是操纵烈焰与烟尘的大师，将所有敢于怀疑你力量的人统统烧成炭渣和灰烬。火焰在你的手中无比的温顺，它尽情的在你的掌上舞动，并且对你的每个念头作出回应

你是烈焰的后裔，你的力量源于炙热的地狱之心，你用咆哮的烈焰灼烧你的敌人或保护你的伙伴。你身边盘旋着不熄的火焰旋风，任何胆敢攻击你的人都会被火焰所烧灼。

火焰存在于你的生命血脉之中，虽然对他人而言意味着毁灭，但是却带给你无穷的活力。那些在战斗中面对你的可怜家伙们并不知道，他们要面对的可不是一个凡人，而是火山之力与熔岩之血，任何胆敢朝你举起武器的人必将感受到烈火焚身的极度痛苦

**野性漫游者 Wildcat Stalker**
「这只猫敏感且凶猛，就如同它的主人一样」

**前提条件：游侠，「兽王」职业特性，野兽伙伴（猫）**

独立、勇气以及机敏的头脑与身体——这正是猫所拥有的。在采取行动之前它喜欢从一个不错的角度来仔细观察。猫都很爱玩耍，通常它们安静且整洁，但是打起架来它们也毫不含糊。这是一个专擅伏击与致命突袭的隐形杀手，它们会以最快的速度结果猎物。当朋友在周围时，猫便会与其分享一切。

你可以从猫的身上看到你自己，同样的你也可以在自己身上看到一点猫的影子。你也是机敏的猎手，拥有猫样的优雅与胆量。突袭与快攻对你来说最为拿手，同时，你也能够照顾好自己。

这也许就是为什么你选择了充满野性的大猫做为你的伙伴（又或者是它选择了你）。你激发了你的猫咪的潜力，在认知、秘密、感觉上获益良多。在你身旁，你的野兽伙伴已经成为一个强大的勇士，利用其攻击技能，击倒你们共同的敌人，就好像它们的游戏那样。

你的大猫的名气也会随着你的事迹而流传。它已经成为那些遇见你的，受你影响的以及反对你的人确认你的一个标志。当讲述你的故事时，在那些神话记述中你的猫会始终站在你的身旁，如同你们是一个整体。

**野性之魂 Feral Spirit**
「He doesn't like you. I don't like you either. Watch yourself―we both bite.」

**前提条件：游侠，「兽王」职业特性**

To most mortals, an animal is a pet or a tool, a companion or a means to an end. Such creatures provide food, labor, protection, and even company. Only in rare cases does the relationship between master and beast transcend these mundane trappings. Every beastmaster is an exception to this generality, learning to become one formidable unit with an animal that is at once a friend, a guardian, and a weapon. Beastmasters know that, after the bond is formed, the capabilities and fate of master and beast are linked.

Beastmasters among many races have nurtured the mystical connection between master and pet. They cultivated communication that transcends speech and approaches telepathy. As such a beastmaster grew in power, the magic of the world infused the relationship. It bound the animal and mortal closer together, driven to do so by the devotion, ritual connection, and common cause the two shared. Contact among peoples spread this technique, which some claim originated with elves.

Elf or not, you've managed to foster such a transcendent relationship with your beast companion. Although each of you is fiercely independent and deadly, you share emotions and thoughts. Each knows when the other is in need. You work in unison to fell your foes, and even your allies swear you act to support each other more quickly than any communication could possibly allow. In time, you might grow so close as to seem like one incredible being sharing two bodies.

title: 伊拉西斯的督军 Dujun of Erathis
body:
**伊拉西斯的督军 Dujun of Erathis**
「When diplomacy and philosophy fail, war brings advancement to the benighted.」

**前提条件：督军**

Progress, taming of the wilds for the good of all, innovation, collaboration, and the rule of law—these are the values Erathis has set before mortals. Yet the nature of the world opposes her. Empires rise like beacons only to be shattered within a few centuries, leaving flickering shards of civilization behind. Still, in each age, a mighty and ambitious few rise to beat back the shadows and create a safe haven for common folk.

Those who follow Erathis's edicts range from plucky adventurers who rid the wilderness of dangers to would-be lords who subdue untamed lands to call their own. The god of civilization delights in the expansion of organized habitation. She blesses those who boldly make way for progress, as well as those who defend existing societies against fell beasts.

To truly and fully take Erathis's dogma to heart is to embrace both cooperation and leadership. You must be educated in the ways of governance and regulation, as well as be cognizant of the follies of history that ravaged the cultures of old. You must look outside the confines of secure walls and take Erathis's banner to new territory. To sit idly within the halls of established civilized edifices simply won't do.

So far, you have proven to be one of the few who can undertake this mission. You know that a true leader must be an authority in combat and in peace, but also be a guide who elicits the help of capable collaborators. You cultivate camaraderie, planning a meaningful role for all in battle and outside it. You have polished your party into the perfect cohesive unit, proven by the extraordinary heights at which it performs under your guidance. Now, it's time to move onward to broader conquest and, perhaps, your own dominion.

你的灵魂引领你踏上研究医术的道路。在战场上，你如同光辉的希望灯塔一般为你的同伴提供医护。当你为伤者提供援助，为濒死者净化灵魂时，你体现了仁慈和关怀--特别是在将对敌人的伤害转化为对队友的治疗时。

title: 遗忘正义之仲裁者 Arbiter of Forgotten Justice
prerequisite: 神导士，必须遵守阿莫斯的戒律
body:
**遗忘正义之仲裁者 Arbiter of Forgotten Justice**
「Though Amoth is gone, all he stood for, all he fought for, remains. My very presence is proof—but if you require more, I shall be happy to deliver.」

**前提条件：神导士，必须遵守阿莫斯的戒律**

Some invokers have learned to harness Amoth's lingering might by using the powers presented above,but a few—a rare but growing few—have gone further.They have devoted themselves in full to Amoth,spreading justice in his memory and drawing at leastin part on his own surviving might to do so.

You are one of these select few. Whether you havededicated yourself exclusively to Amoth's teachings,or serve other gods of justice in memory of Amoth,you draw upon the lingering energy of the murderedLord of kalandurren. As an arbiter of forgotten justice, you know that one must deal with the evils thatplague mortals and gods alike. Their crimes must bepunished—from simple human greed to the murder ofAmoth.

**11级：惩治行动 Retributive Action**
